verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly offer event-triggered automation, such as filing-status alerts or webhooks, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes user-defined rules, triggers or automatic actions. The Gateway and tax pages cover only profile updates, filing tips, OHID sign-in and tax services, and the ohiosos.gov hosts returned 403 at robots.txt, so no further evidence was retrieved.
